root.claim: One deterministic fixed-alphabet multitape Turing machine multiplies two $n$-bit integers exactly in $O(n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa})$ time with $\kappa=2^{-182}$.
root.method: reduce the product to a cyclic convolution of radix digits, move it by a Chinese-remainder map and Gaussian resampling to power-of-two axes, compute that convolution with synthetic polynomial transforms accelerated by two network-based tape procedures, recover the exact coefficients by rounding, and bound every cost term

motivation.text: The Harvey and van der Hoeven route already reaches $O(n\log n)$; its remaining cost is a full scan per transform level for both address rearrangement and butterflies, so a power saving in those two tape operations lowers the whole bound.

adds.name: input length
adds.meaning: The number of bits in each of the two input integers.

adds.name: logical volume
adds.meaning: The number of stored data bits of the array a tape procedure acts on.

adds.name: wire count
adds.meaning: The number of wires (roles) in a fixed finite network.

adds.name: label dimension
adds.meaning: The dimension of the fixed tensor label space, and the factor by which the recursion parameter grows per level.

adds.name: smaller calls
adds.meaning: The number of smaller recursive calls one network invocation needs, the sum of its edge ranks or residual dimensions.

adds.name: working precision
adds.meaning: The number of fractional bits of the fixed-point grid used for complex coefficients.

adds.name: axis count
adds.meaning: The number of axes of the multidimensional transforms, of order $p^\epsilon$.

adds.name: record length
adds.meaning: The number of complex coefficients in each polynomial record modulo $y^r+1$.

adds.name: padded box size
adds.meaning: The number of entries of the padded power-of-two box, the product of the axis lengths $t_i$.

adds.name: interchange exponent
adds.meaning: The fixed exponent $1-2^{-50}$ below one in the chunk-interchange bound.
